whyWeLikeIt: A soft bag keeps the cold food together and leaves a hand free, and the listing describes an easy-clean insulated interior. It also carries as a tote or on your back.
limitations: The listing does not say whether the main compartment zips shut (only the front pocket is described) or that the liner is sealed, and it holds about a dozen cans, so it suits two to four people, not a crowd. Pair it with ice packs, since food safety depends on staying cold.
